The language itself is fluent, but the structural presentation hinders natural reading flow.

evaluation.overall_comment: A linguistically accurate and terminologically strong translation that faithfully renders a complex physics podcast into Nepali. The main drawback lies in editorial/formatting quality: merged speaker tags and repeated lines severely disrupt script readability. With basic proofreading and proper line breaks, this would easily reach high-quality status. Linguistically and scientifically, it is excellent; structurally, it needs refinement.
